issues.description: Element: Farm.addAnimal(Animal). The UML in problem_statement.md (Farm class diagram) marks addAnimal(animal: Animal):void with a '-' (private). The template Main.java calls farm.addAnimal(...) as a public API. The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) provides addAnimal(...) as public. This visibility mismatch is confusing because students following the UML might implement addAnimal as private (or omit a public signature), but the provided Main example and tests expect a public method, which would lead to compilation errors or extra work reconciling the differences.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Update the UML in problem_statement.md to mark addAnimal(Animal) as public ('+') to match the Main example and the solution. Also add a public addAnimal(Animal) method signature (stub) to the template Farm.java so students implement it as part of the public API. Alternatively (less recommended), remove public calls to addAnimal from Main and adjust the solution to avoid requiring a public addAnimal method.
